text:
Courtney (AE): VerdantCap just emailed asking for compliance artifacts before the POC. They listed SOC 2 evidence, a recent pentest/va attestation, and an HSM/KMS statement. They want everything before kickoff next Wednesday.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Can we meet that timeline? I can produce a condensed dedicated deployment diagram and a provisioning timeline, but dedicated GPUs usually take 10 business days after contract.
Priya (InfoSec): We have a 2025 vulnerability assessment report (third-party) and a short remediation summary that we can share. They asked specifically for a signed attestation 'confirming assessment within last 12 months'.
Marcus (Legal): We can sign a one-page attestation. Need exact wording and assessor name. Prefer limited scope language to avoid exposing internal details.
Courtney (AE): Copy of their ask (verbatim):
- SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter
- Signed vuln/pentest attestation (third-party acceptable)
- Evidence of KMS/HSM usage for key custody
- Diagram and timeline for dedicated deployment
- Confirmation on whether customer scans are permitted during POC
Priya (InfoSec): We should provide: (1) SOC 2 bridge letter if SOC2 report distribution is restricted, (2) attestation letter with assessor name/date/high-level scope, (3) redacted remediation summary. No raw vuln data.
Leah (CS): On scans: standard policy is yes under an NDA + scan window + allowlist. I can draft the POC scan rules and contact points.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Proposed timeline snippet I can send:
- Day 0: signed SOW
- Day 1-3: provision network + VPC peering prep
- Day 4-10: GPU pool allocation & testing (region dependent)
- Day 11: POC kickoff (estimate)
Marcus (Legal): I'll prepare attestation template. Priya, please share assessor name and confirmation that the engagement included external authenticated testing or internal scope (we need to be precise).
Priya (InfoSec): Assessor: RedSec Labs. Engagement: external, authenticated scan + focused manual verification. Date: 2025-08-12. I'll redact any sensitive findings.
AuditBot: Evidence ticket created: https://redwood.internal/audit/requests/VC-2026-011 (owner: Priya, due: 2026-04-02)
Courtney (AE): I'll reply to VerdantCap to request their NDA signee for scan permission and give them a temporary S3 link for artifacts.
Leah (CS): I'll write the POC runbook section about scan windows, throttle limits, and escalation contact.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Network diagram preview I'll attach: 
```
gw-vpc-verdant
subnets: app-public, infer-private
ingress: ALB -> public
kms: us-east-1 (customer-managed optional)
```
Marcus (Legal): Once Priya posts the draft attestation to the shared drive I'll review and sign via DocuSign. If they ask for notarization that's extra lead time.
Priya (InfoSec): Draft attestation will be in the shared folder by EOD today.
Courtney (AE): Action items: Priya draft attestation + redacted remediation summary; Diego diagram + timeline; Leah POC scan rules; Marcus legal sign-off; Courtney to send initial reply and artifact link.
Leah (CS): FYI I'll include a short bullet about allowed scan tools (nmap, nessus with creds) and an internal contact for escalation.
Courtney (AE): Thanks all. I'll post the customer reply and update the ticket when uploaded. :white_check_mark:
